name: Tesla Holiday Pop Up
summary: Tesla Holiday Pop Up is a temporary retail location in Salinas offering direct access to Tesla's electric vehicles and sustainable energy products. Open daily from 10 AM to 9 PM, this pop-up provides the Central Coast community with personalized consultations and test drive opportunities for Tesla's innovative automotive technology.
demographics: The Tesla Holiday Pop Up at Northridge Drive in Salinas attracts a tech-savvy, environmentally conscious demographic with above-average income levels, typically ranging from upper-middle to high-income households. The visitor base skews toward professionals aged 30-55 who are early adopters of electric vehicle technology and sustainable products. Given Salinas' position as an agricultural hub with growing suburban development, the location draws both local residents interested in premium automotive technology and visitors from the broader Monterey Bay area seeking innovative retail experiences.
description: Tesla Holiday Pop Up represents a unique temporary retail concept located at 796 Northridge Drive in Salinas, California. This innovative pop-up location brings Tesla's cutting-edge electric vehicle technology and sustainable energy products directly to the Central Coast community during the holiday season. Operating from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, the pop-up provides an accessible touchpoint for residents of Salinas and the surrounding Monterey County region to experience Tesla's full lineup of electric vehicles, solar products, and energy storage solutions. The location strategically positions Tesla in a growing market area, offering personalized consultations, test drive opportunities, and hands-on demonstrations of the company's revolutionary automotive and energy technologies. As a temporary retail activation, this pop-up exemplifies Tesla's direct-to-consumer sales model and commitment to expanding electric vehicle adoption throughout California's diverse communities.
